items.title: Why Pfizer (PFE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of global pharmaceutical company Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) jumped 3.8% in the afternoon session after positive clinical trial results from peers Merck and Moderna for an mRNA cancer treatment lifted sentiment across the pharmaceutical sector.

items.title: BioNTech Stock Surges 22% on Moderna Cancer Vaccine Win. Why the Gains Could Fade.
items.summary: BioNTech, a former pioneer of mRNA cancer vaccines, was part of a broad rally Wednesday. Leerink analysts don’t expect the momentum to last.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 19: Moderna Skyrockets 177% on Positive Phase 3 Melanoma Data
items.summary: Today, Aug. 19, 2026, Moderna's personalized cancer vaccine met its late-stage goal, with the company and Merck planning an FDA submission.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson Stock Runs On A Calendar The Market Does Not Set
items.summary: The stock has stood out while the index has barely moved, but the number that matters for a portfolio is how little of its return comes from the market.

items.title: Is AbbVie Stock About To Break Out Again?
items.summary: AbbVie's upside case now turns on one pending dosing change for the medicine that supplies close to a third of guided revenue, and management expects it to speed up sales.

items.title: Which Drugmaker Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Merck, Pfizer, or Amgen?
items.summary: One large-cap drugmaker has quietly lapped its peers in 2026 without a single obesity drug in its lineup, while the companies chasing the hottest trend in pharma are fighting for second place and last.

items.title: OPK Raises $125 Million Against Royalties: What Investors Should Know
items.summary: OPKO Health secured $125 million in royalty-backed financing, adding non-dilutive capital while retaining long-term exposure to mazdutide growth in China.

items.title: Is OPK Worth Buying as Valuation Meets Improving Business Trends?
items.summary: OPKO Health pairs a discounted forward sales multiple with narrowing losses and partnership support, but early-stage clinical risk keeps the investment case balanced.
